The residence

Aurore

The single 3+1 the developer has released at Marina Orikum: one of seventy plans, and the only one of its type. Second floor of Building B, full sea view, 95.85 m² net. What sets it apart is the veranda — 148.03 m², half again the area of the apartment itself, wrapping the plan along its full width and around the front, and deep enough to hold a lounge, a dining table and a garden. Inside, as drawn: two bedrooms, two bathrooms and a separate WC off the hall, with an open living, dining and kitchen on the eastern side. A note in fairness — the developer's own sheet types this apartment 3+1, but the drawing shows two bedroom doors off the hall, not three. We have described what is drawn and are checking the discrepancy with the developer. Low in the building, which is where a veranda this size does its best work.

Terms

How an off-plan purchase is staged

The developer's payment schedule, as supplied. Instalments follow construction, not the calendar — you pay against work completed and inspected.

  1. 30%on signing the contract
  2. 35%on completion of the structural framework
  3. 30%on completion of plastering and gypsum works, including first-fix electrical, plumbing and mechanical
  4. 5%on handover of keys

The building permit has been obtained and construction begins within 30 days of the developer's rate card. Completion is approximately three years.

Location & setting

Second floor, and a veranda the size of a garden

Marina Orikum sits in the Gulf of Vlorë — the only marina between the Adriatic and the Ionian, sheltered by the Karaburun peninsula, the island of Sazan and the Llogara national park behind. It has served yachts along both coasts for over twenty years and is being extended to 800 berths, with apartments, villas, a five-star hotel and a promenade of shops and restaurants around it. Vlorë is 100 km from Tirana and 79 km from Saranda, and the new international airport at Vlorë is about to open.

Marina Orikum is designed by architect Chris Precht and developed by Concord Investment Group.

Në shqip

Aurore — Marina Orikum

I vetmi apartament 3+1 në këtë ofertë — në katin e dytë të Godinës B, me pamje të plotë nga deti.

Apartamenti ka 95.85 m² neto. Veranda prej 148.03 m² është gjysmë here më e madhe se vetë apartamenti: hapësirë për një zonë ndenjeje, një tavolinë ngrënieje dhe gjelbërim, përgjatë gjithë gjerësisë së planimetrisë.

Sipërfaqja neto 95.85 m² · Sipërfaqja totale 111.61 m² · Pamje nga deti · Kati 2 · çmimi indikativ €3,500/m². Çmimi jepet për m², sipas katit dhe pozicionit; brezi i çmimeve është €3,200–3,600/m². Sipërfaqet janë matur nga jashtë objektit dhe në aks të mureve të përbashkëta me fqinjin dhe në aks të mureve të shkallëve.

  1. 30%në nënshkrimin e kontratës
  2. 35%në përfundim të strukturës
  3. 30%në përfundim të suvatimit dhe punimeve me gips, përfshirë instalimet e para elektrike, hidraulike dhe mekanike
  4. 5%në dorëzimin e çelësave
